latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — test and compare two caption styles on uploaded videos.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB and get automatic A/B caption testing.
- Quickly generate and compare captioned video variants in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple backend connection and session setup—no manual installation required.
- View and manage credits, video status, file uploads, and export tasks from chat.
- Error handling and usage tips included to streamline the editing workflow.
